args.title: Add field length and count limits to API reference
args.body:
File: docs/api/reference.md

The API reference currently does not mention the limits on report fields such as the maximum length of the name (120 characters), the maximum number of recipients (20), or the maximum number of categories (50). These limits are enforced by the server but absent from the documentation, causing validation errors without advance warning. This change proposes to add these constraints to the Reports section to help clients validate input before submitting.
